# tiny-tools

> tiny-tools by AVRG3 includes tiny-context for file analysis and tiny-runtime for resumable API batches, retry-loop detection and progress-based cache hints. tiny-context: local MCP tools for agents seeking fewer steps and less context on large-file tasks. SQL over spreadsheets, repeated-error log summaries, and targeted PDF/Office retrieval. No tool telemetry. Requires a connected MCP client; discovery alone does not activate tools.

Install (any MCP client, stdio): `npx -y -p https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/releases/download/context-v0.1.1/tiny-context-standalone-0.1.1.tgz tiny-context-mcp`

## Discovery and bundles
- [Official MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/?q=io.github.Warddamn%2Ftiny-context): active listing, io.github.Warddamn/tiny-context version 0.1.1, GitHub-hosted MCPB packages with SHA-256 hashes.
- [Glama](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/Warddamn/tiny-tools): existing indexed repository listing.
- [MCPB bundles](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/releases/tag/context-v0.1.1): choose macOS (darwin), Windows (win32) or Linux. Includes dependencies for x64/arm64; requires Node.js 20+ or a compatible host-provided runtime. Use the npx command above for clients without MCPB support.

## Docs
- [Repository README](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools#readme): packages, install, benchmarks, honest comparison
- [tiny-context README](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/tree/main/packages/context#readme): the 8 tools, CLI, MCP config, hook
- [Agent usage snippet](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/blob/main/packages/context/docs/AGENT_USAGE.md): 6 lines to paste into CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/blob/main/bench/RESULTS.md) and [comparison vs. a shell-capable agent](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/blob/main/evals/COMPARISON.md)

## Tools (tiny-context)
file_map · query_file · read_section · query_table · summarize_log · diff_files · validate_file · extract

[Try three tasks with expected answers](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/blob/main/QUICKSTART.md). Requires a connected MCP client; finding this page does not install or activate the tools.

## Choose by task
- Repeated errors in a large log: summarize_log(path, focus="errors"). Returns clustered messages, counts and time ranges.
- Totals, counts or grouping in CSV/XLSX/Parquet: query_table(path, sql). SQL table name is t; returns bounded result rows.
- A clause, topic or section in PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX: file_map, then query_file or read_section. Returns locations and bounded excerpts.
- Short plain-text notes and exact-string searches: use the agent's normal Read or Grep when suitable.

## Evidence limits
One 12-task Claude comparison, not a guarantee: log analysis fell from 7 turns to 3, same correct answer; tools-only total time 193s to 104s, processed tokens 1,488,617 to 1,192,953. Some tasks got worse. The 99.9% whole-file benchmark uses a different baseline and does not estimate general agent savings.


## tiny-runtime: API pagination, retry loops and tool progress

Install (stdio, Node.js 20+): `npx -y -p https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/releases/download/runtime-v0.1.1/tiny-runtime-0.1.1.tgz tiny-runtime-mcp`

- [Runtime README](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/tree/main/packages/runtime#readme): install, HTTP cursor mapping, checkpoint semantics, measured-state guards and cache-adapter contract.
- [Runtime quickstart](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/blob/main/packages/runtime/QUICKSTART.md): three synthetic tasks with checkable answers.
- [Runtime MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/?q=io.github.Warddamn%2Ftiny-runtime): active `io.github.Warddamn/tiny-runtime` version 0.1.1; archive hash verified against the public release.
- [Runtime release](https://github.com/Warddamn/tiny-tools/releases/tag/runtime-v0.1.1): portable MCPB with dependencies and a small npx tarball.
- collect_pages(config, checkpoint?): fetch configured cursor pages, validate totals/snapshots, optionally deduplicate IDs and sum integer minor units. Returns complete/partial/failed and local records/checkpoint paths. Pass checkpoint paths directly, do not read their rows into model context. No automatic retries or source writes.
- check_progress(path): inspect a tool trace for repeated failures/stalls/cycles against trusted state fingerprints. Returns a decision and report. Automatic blocking uses RepeatGuard/runGuarded in the host; installation alone does not intercept other tools.
- plan_cache(path): derive expiring retain/prefetch/release hints from instrumented tool-progress traces. Advisory only; live SDK delivery requires a compatible serving-engine adapter. No hosted-model cache control or measured GPU savings claimed.
- Prefer existing correct scripts, one simple API request, and normal Read/Grep for small inputs. No model calls or telemetry. Explicit HTTP sources and optional engine adapters use the network. npm installation also downloads dependencies.
